dedupe_keys.name: bhutan medium voltage electricity network points

description: The national spatial-data service exposes a medium-voltage point layer with pole, conductor, voltage, transformer and location attribute definitions. Service metadata identify a queryable ArcGIS feature view and several supported export formats. The provider is National Land Commission Secretariat NSDI; asset custodian not established. Coverage: Coverage is Bhutan as indicated by the national service and layer extent. The service uses Web Mercator, EPSG:3857; survey dates, positional accuracy and national completeness are unknown. Access: Only service and layer metadata were requested. No feature query or geographic data export was performed. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Point assets alone do not establish connected network topology. Empty service descriptions leave reuse rights, custodian details and data quality unverified. For simulation it supplies a route to medium-voltage asset points and attribute definitions. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this named NSDI electricity layer.
